data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'w-y-h' meaning 'to endure, remain, or last'. The name Muayyah carries the meaning “She who endures” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
